mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties that potentiate each other, and tolterodine inhibits CYP2D6 which metabolizes amitriptyline, increasing amitriptyline levels.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic adverse effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, cognitive effects); consider dose reduction of amitriptyline or use alternative antimuscarinic agent if clinically feasible.
